### func [NewPlayerBytes](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/server/init.go#L365>)

```go
func NewPlayerBytes(info []byte) (Player, int)
```

Will construct a new player from a byte array\. Will return the offset where the player stops\.

Attention this function will not return an error if any of the given lengths are incorrect\, as this function should never actually be used on the server side\, but is primarily used for testing purposes\.

Needed are: \- UserId           \(1 byte\) \- StringLength \[n\] \(2 bytes\) \- String           \(n bytes\)

## type [ServerOpcode](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/server/init.go#L19>)

A Server Opcode represents the internal representations of all the defined server side operational codes that control the game flow\.

see definition here: https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/docs/wiki/Protocol#server

```go
type ServerOpcode uint8
```

```go
const (
    DisconnectOpcode        ServerOpcode = 0x64
    UnknownOpcode           ServerOpcode = 0x65
    MovementPlayerOpcode    ServerOpcode = 0x6E
    TeleportPlayerOpcode    ServerOpcode = 0x6F
    ShootingPlayerOpcode    ServerOpcode = 0x70
    PlayerDeathOpcode       ServerOpcode = 0x78
    PlayerJoinedOpcode      ServerOpcode = 0x7A
    PlayerLeftOpcode        ServerOpcode = 0x7B
    YouAreCalledOpcode      ServerOpcode = 0x7C
    SendAllPlayerInfoOpcode ServerOpcode = 0x82
    SendAllPlayerKDOpcode   ServerOpcode = 0x83
    MapChangeOpcode         ServerOpcode = 0x8C
)
```

### func [Detect](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/server/init.go#L74>)

```go
func Detect(opcode uint8) ServerOpcode
```

Detect converts from the an external byte into the internally used ServerOpcode type\.

Will return Unknown when there is no mapping for the given value\.

